name: career-caddy-sender
description: Career Caddy browser extension — Glimmer UI, MV3, Chrome + Firefox.

scripts.build: npm run bump && npm run gate:layering && npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: vite build --mode chrome && npm run gate -- chrome && npm run gate:injected -- chrome
scripts.build:firefox: vite build --mode firefox && npm run gate -- firefox && npm run gate:injected -- firefox
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
